examples.description: Suggest three vertical shorts from a long video, looking for the product demo
Suggest square feed clips from one uploaded video on the timeline

description: Find the best short-form moments in a long studio video and return them as ranges with a title, a hook line, a one-sentence rationale and measured evidence (captioned words, words per second, whether it starts on a scene cut). It creates and changes nothing. To make a suggestion into a project, call studio.create_social_clip with its start_ms and end_ms; then render that project with video.export_create and the same preset. Pass count (1 to 10), target_preset (default shorts_9x16; it sets the shape and the longest length, never over 60 s) and optionally asset_id to use only the scenes cut from one uploaded video. Costs up to about $0.0012 per call for the model; the wallet is checked first and an unfunded wallet gets PAYMENT_REQUIRED with nothing charged. Refuses, with nothing charged: a project with no finished footage (COLD_START: add footage with studio.add_scene_from_asset or studio.generate_scene), an asset_id that is not a video or not on the timeline yet (place it with studio.add_scene_from_asset), footage shorter than 5 s, read-only tokens and viewer roles. A pick outside the real footage is dropped with its reason in 'dropped', never stretched to fit.

asset_id.description: Optional: suggest only from the scenes cut from this video asset (vas_...). studio.get_composition lists the assets; the asset must already be on the timeline (studio.add_scene_from_asset places it).

count.description: How many suggestions to return, 1 to 10 (default 3). Fewer can come back when the video has fewer distinct moments.

focus.description: Optional: what to look for, such as 'the product demo'. It only ranks moments; it is never treated as an instruction.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_...) holding the long video. studio_project_list shows your projects.

target_preset.description: The export preset the shorts are for (default shorts_9x16). It sets the shape and the longest allowed length; pass the same preset to studio.create_social_clip and video.export_create.

name: studio.suggest_social_clips
